original_text: Among modern clustering approaches, centroid neural network (CentNN) \cite{park2000centroid} is a prototype-based algorithm that follows a competitive-learning paradigm, where centroid vectors are updated online through winner-loser dynamics.
injected_text: Among modern clustering approaches, centroid neural network (CentNN) \cite{park2000centroid} is a density-based algorithm that follows a competitive-learning paradigm, where centroid vectors are updated online through winner-loser dynamics.
rationale: Swapping 'prototype-based' to 'density-based' miscategorises the fundamental methodology of the cited algorithm (CentNN), presenting a realistic within-domain author error that directly contradicts the cited paper.
ground_truth_description: The methodology of the cited paper (park2000centroid) was incorrectly changed from a 'prototype-based' algorithm to a 'density-based' algorithm.

original_text: Experiments on some benchmark datasets show that FastCentNN consistently achieves clustering quality comparable to CentNN while reducing runtime by up to 16\% on synthetic 2D datasets and about 5\% on high-dimensional datasets.
injected_text: Experiments on some benchmark datasets show that FastCentNN consistently achieves clustering quality comparable to CentNN while reducing runtime by up to 16\% on synthetic 2D datasets but increasing it by about 5\% on high-dimensional datasets.
rationale: The abstract is modified to claim a runtime increase on high-dimensional datasets, directly contradicting Section 3.3 and the Conclusion which report a consistent ~5% speed-up on MNIST and Fashion-MNIST.
ground_truth_description: The abstract was modified to state that FastCentNN increases runtime on high-dimensional datasets, creating a clear internal contradiction with the speed-ups reported in the Results.
